scope: Direct novelty-collision audit for the ten CooperScene throughput-only candidates retained by cooperative-autonomous-driving-cooperscene-candidate-pool-v2.json.

method.evidencePolicy: Collision decisions use only primary paper, publisher, author-project, dataset-project, and official-code URLs verified during the frozen search. Absence means not found in the frozen corpus, not proof that no prior work exists.
method.publicationWindow: 2023-2026, with a 2022 arXiv version retained only where the work was formally published in 2023.
method.claimRule: Generic trace replay, real-network evaluation, communication-impairment testing, temporal compensation, collaborator selection, and payload-aware evaluation are treated as occupied. Only the narrower controlled deltas stated per candidate may be retained.

primarySources.title: CooperScene: Multi-Modal Cooperative Autonomy Benchmark with C-V2X Communication Characterization
verifiedEvidence: The release provides synchronized pairwise C-V2X throughput traces and reports real C-V2X latency, packet loss, throughput, and perception degradation.

The public cooperative evaluation path uses a scalar cv2x_throughput, payload divided by throughput, optional uniform overhead, and integer 100 ms frame conversion rather than loading the released per-frame MCAP trace.
The Table 2 script defaults every agent setting to 1.6 Mbps.

primarySources.title: CADET: A Modular Platform for Evaluating Distributed Cooperative Autonomy in Connected Autonomous Vehicles
primarySources.venueOrStatus: arXiv preprint; formal venue not verified
verifiedEvidence: CADET explicitly claims trace-driven network and workload emulation for cooperative autonomy.
NetWaggle supports replayable latency, jitter, packet-loss, and bandwidth profiles and links system behavior to task outcomes.
The frozen search did not verify a CooperScene-specific exact-order versus marginal/block-shuffle audit.

primarySources.title: Boosting Collaborative Vehicular Perception on the Edge with Vehicle-to-Vehicle Communication
verifiedEvidence: Harbor evaluates collaborative vehicular perception with real-world tests and trace-driven emulation.
It performs runtime helper-helpee assignment under changing network and traffic conditions.
No official code URL was verified in the frozen search.

primarySources.title: V2X-ReaLO: An Open Online Framework and Dataset for Cooperative Perception in Reality
primarySources.venueOrStatus: arXiv preprint; formal venue not verified
verifiedEvidence: V2X-ReaLO replays synchronized ROS bags at real-time rates and evaluates online early, late, and intermediate fusion.
It measures average communication latency and injects that latency in single-machine evaluation.
It does not establish exact CooperScene C-V2X trace replay or a marginal/block-shuffle temporal audit.
No official public implementation was verified in the frozen search.

primarySources.title: RCP-Bench: Benchmarking Robustness for Collaborative Perception Under Diverse Corruptions
verifiedEvidence: RCP-Bench compares ten collaborative perception models under synthetic corruptions and temporal misalignment.
RCP-Drop randomly removes collaborator data to model sensor or communication failures.
It is not a measured directed C-V2X trace replay and does not preserve then selectively destroy observed temporal structure.

primarySources.title: Latency Robust Cooperative Perception using Asynchronous Feature Fusion
verifiedEvidence: LRCP directly addresses non-discrete communication delay with historical BEV features and flow-guided asynchronous fusion.
Its published evaluation uses configured latency ranges on public perception datasets rather than the released CooperScene directed throughput traces.

primarySources.title: Learning for Vehicle-to-Vehicle Cooperative Perception under Lossy Communication
verifiedEvidence: The paper studies cooperative perception under lossy communication and proposes feature repair and attention.
The official repository contained only a coming-soon notice when verified; no executable implementation was established.

primarySources.title: R-ACP: Real-Time Adaptive Collaborative Perception Leveraging Robust Task-Oriented Communications
primarySources.venueOrStatus: arXiv preprint; formal venue not verified
verifiedEvidence: R-ACP optimizes information timeliness, adapts compression to channel capacity, and filters corrupted features.
The frozen search did not verify exact replay of released CooperScene traces or source code.

primarySources.title: SEE-V2X: C-V2X Direct Communication Dataset: An Application-Centric Approach
verifiedEvidence: SEE-V2X publishes application-layer and lower-layer C-V2X traces from multiple participants and analyzes throughput, packet loss, latency, and jitter.
The frozen search did not verify a cooperative-perception model replay or temporal shuffle audit using those traces.

primarySources.title: When Autonomous Vehicle Meets V2X Cooperative Perception: How Far Are We?
primarySources.venueOrStatus: arXiv preprint; formal venue not verified
verifiedEvidence: The study injects randomly sampled communication latency and pose error into online cooperative driving experiments.
It shows that communication interference can change perception and driving outcomes, but it does not replay CooperScene traces or isolate trace temporal structure.

candidates.title: 吞吐积分驱动的模型载荷完成回放

closestPriorWork.reason: Same dataset, same supported models, real C-V2X measurements, and an existing payload-over-throughput delay path.
Closest generic trace-driven cooperative-autonomy replay platform.
Closest formal systems paper using trace-driven collaborative-perception emulation.

overlap: Real-network-aware cooperative perception evaluation is already established.
Trace-driven emulation is already established outside the exact CooperScene model path.
CooperScene already relates model payload size and throughput to staleness and perception performance.
delta: Use the released directed CooperScene throughput samples as the executable service process for each actual model payload.
Compare continuous payload completion against the public scalar-throughput and 100 ms integer-frame implementation under the same checkpoint and LiDAR sample.
Report log-time and publish-time interpretations separately instead of inventing missing latency, loss, or jitter.
candidates.recommendationReason: The generic replay claim is occupied, but the repository-specific executable audit of the public fixed-throughput abstraction remains a defensible delta. It is strongest as the substrate for the temporal-structure candidate.
allowedClaims: First verified CooperScene implementation study in this frozen corpus that drives supported-model payload completion from the released directed throughput sequence and contrasts it with the public fixed-throughput code path.
forbiddenClaims: First trace-driven cooperative perception benchmark.
First real-network cooperative perception evaluation.
Exact replay of measured latency, loss, jitter, MAC scheduling, or packet delivery.

candidates.title: 吞吐时间结构的最小充分性检验

closestPriorWork.reason: Replays realistic network dynamics for cooperative autonomy but does not document the proposed hierarchy of exact order, marginal shuffle, and block shuffle.
Uses trace-driven emulation for collaborative vehicular perception without the controlled temporal-sufficiency decomposition verified here.
Stress-tests robustness and temporal misalignment, but uses constructed corruptions rather than a measured-trace invariance ladder.

overlap: Network impairment and trace realism are occupied problem families.
Robustness comparisons across communication conditions are occupied.
delta: Hold the empirical throughput marginal distribution exactly fixed while selectively destroying order.
Use independent permutation and declared-duration block permutation to identify the minimum temporal structure needed to recover payload-completion conclusions.
Evaluate method-ranking stability as an outcome of the intervention, not as an assumed contribution.
candidates.recommendationReason: This is the sharpest falsifiable gap left after removing generic trace replay. Its contribution is the controlled sufficiency test and resulting validity boundary, including a useful null result.
allowedClaims: A CooperScene-specific causal audit of whether throughput marginals, short-range temporal blocks, or full order are sufficient for payload-completion and frozen-model conclusions.
forbiddenClaims: First study of temporal correlation or burst loss in wireless networks.
First trace-driven V2X evaluation.
Measured loss or jitter fidelity when those fields are absent from the audited trace schema.

candidates.title: 十二条定向链路的同步吞吐结构审计

closestPriorWork.reason: Publishes synchronized pairwise throughput and attributes variation to mobility and channel contention.
Provides multi-participant C-V2X traces and cross-layer evidence for application traffic.
Evaluates multi-vehicle collaborative perception under changing network topology.

overlap: Multi-agent link variation and contention are already observed.
Multi-vehicle network-aware perception evaluation is already established.
delta: Preserve each directed link's marginal sequence while independently breaking or commonly preserving cross-link timing.
Measure joint payload completion sets under equal payload and deadline, rather than merely reporting per-link throughput.
Avoid claiming a shared physical cause because the audited trace lacks lower-layer scheduling evidence.
candidates.recommendationReason: The data object is already central to CooperScene, but the synchronized-versus-independent cross-link intervention was not found. It is valuable as a multi-agent extension of the temporal-sufficiency study, not a separate paper-sized claim.
allowedClaims: Controlled audit of whether released cross-link synchronization changes joint model-payload completion.
forbiddenClaims: Discovery of shared-channel causality.
Replay of packet-level contention or MAC scheduling.
First analysis of C-V2X multi-agent contention.

candidates.title: MCAP 与 LiDAR 场景时间对齐契约

closestPriorWork.reason: Uses PTP and hardware triggering and releases synchronized sensor and throughput data.
Synchronizes and replays multi-agent ROS bags by GPS time for online evaluation.

overlap: Multi-agent timestamp synchronization and replay alignment are already explicit benchmark concerns.
A timestamp manifest is standard reproducibility engineering.
delta: Machine-checkable comparison of MCAP log time, publish time, and released LiDAR timestamp domains.
Pre-inference reject path when no bounded monotonic mapping is defensible.
candidates.recommendationReason: The contract is necessary to prevent invalid replay conclusions, but it is data QA rather than an independently novel research idea.
allowedClaims: Reproducibility and validity contract for the retained CooperScene replay study.
forbiddenClaims: Novel temporal-alignment method.
Unique clock ground truth when the released files do not establish one.

candidates.title: 基于历史吞吐完成概率的截止时间准入

closestPriorWork.reason: Optimizes information timeliness and adapts feature compression to channel capacity.
Performs robust runtime helper-helpee assignment under network and topology dynamics.
Motivates adaptive cooperation from highly dynamic measured throughput.

overlap: Channel-aware collaborator selection and deadline/timeliness optimization are occupied.
Adaptive payload and compression decisions under network constraints are occupied.
delta: A deliberately minimal history-only completion-probability rule evaluated on held-out contiguous CooperScene traces.
Exact payload-budget matching and a future-throughput oracle used only as a nondeployable upper bound.
No learned perception or channel model is needed for the initial test.
candidates.recommendationReason: The remaining delta is an evaluation-controlled baseline rather than a strong new mechanism. Revisit only after the replay audit proves temporal structure materially changes decisions.
allowedClaims: A history-only trace baseline built on the retained replay substrate.
forbiddenClaims: First channel-aware cooperative-perception admission method.
First deadline-aware collaborator selection method.

candidates.title: 低共降吞吐的协作者组合

closestPriorWork.reason: Closest formal runtime helper assignment and hybrid V2V/V2I collaboration work under changing network conditions.
Closest channel-aware collaborative selection and timeliness optimization work.
Provides the multi-agent directed throughput substrate and shows strong agent-count/network interactions.

overlap: Network-aware partner selection is already an active and directly competing family.
Robust helper assignment under dynamic links is already a central Harbor mechanism.
delta: Use held-out cross-link co-degradation rather than only mean/recent link quality.
Enforce equal partner count and payload and evaluate worst-window joint completion.
candidates.recommendationReason: The portfolio framing is an incremental selection heuristic over a crowded collaborator-selection family. Keep it only as an ablation inside the cross-link audit.
allowedClaims: Cross-link-diversity ablation for the retained synchronization audit.
forbiddenClaims: New general partner-selection paradigm.
Causal robustness from observed co-degradation alone.

candidates.title: 基于完成时刻的历史 LiDAR 特征传播

closestPriorWork.reason: Directly uses cached historical BEV features and non-discrete delay compensation.
Stores reconstructed collaborator features in a Feature Bank and retrieves temporally close messages.
Evaluates online driving degradation under communication latency and delayed cooperative information.

overlap: Historical-feature buffering, latest-valid feature retrieval, and continuous-latency compensation are directly occupied.
Online evaluation of delayed cooperative input is occupied.
delta: Select the latest actually completable historical frame from the CooperScene throughput-derived scheduler.
Use the selection as a semantics-correct baseline without proposing a new temporal fusion architecture.
candidates.recommendationReason: The only defensible delta is scheduler semantics. A standalone temporal propagation claim would collide with LRCP and V2X-ReaLO.
allowedClaims: Completion-valid prior-frame baseline for the retained replay audit.
forbiddenClaims: Novel asynchronous fusion or temporal compensation method.
First use of buffered historical features in online cooperative perception.

candidates.title: 十四个 take 的 trace 发布一致性契约

closestPriorWork.reason: The official release defines the take, MCAP, mini-set, and benchmark layout being validated.

overlap: Dataset release validation and schema manifests are expected benchmark engineering.
The CooperScene project already documents release layout and MCAP separation.
delta: Strict per-take accept-or-reject manifest before pooled replay.
Explicit no-MCAP boundary for the mini set and no schema extrapolation from take 9.
candidates.recommendationReason: This protects validity and reproducibility but does not support an independent novelty claim.
allowedClaims: Release-integrity gate for the retained experiment.
forbiddenClaims: Novel benchmark method by itself.
Cross-take consistency before every take passes the manifest.

candidates.title: 模型载荷归一化后的吞吐完成边界

closestPriorWork.reason: Already publishes per-method sharing size, C-V2X latency, unlimited-network accuracy, and C-V2X accuracy.
Evaluates accuracy and latency under trace-driven collaborative-perception communication.
Directly studies compression, channel capacity, timeliness, and perception trade-offs.

overlap: Payload/communication/accuracy frontiers are directly occupied.
CooperScene itself makes model payload size a central explanatory variable.
delta: Use instrumented executable payload bytes rather than only reported table values.
Separate actual-payload results from an equal-payload scheduling counterfactual while keeping checkpoints frozen.
Treat ranking change as a possible result, not a guaranteed contribution.
candidates.recommendationReason: Equal-payload counterfactual is a useful attribution test, but the broader frontier claim is already central to CooperScene and communication-efficient CP literature.
allowedClaims: Payload-normalized attribution analysis inside the retained temporal-fidelity study.
forbiddenClaims: First payload-accuracy frontier for cooperative perception.
Method superiority after changing payload without running a valid corresponding model representation.

candidates.title: 发送与接收方向不可互换性检验

closestPriorWork.reason: Releases pairwise directed throughput and reports time-varying C-V2X behavior.
Provides real multi-participant C-V2X application and lower-layer traces.
Provides replayable network profiles but no verified CooperScene direction-swap intervention.

overlap: Directed and time-varying V2X link measurement is occupied.
Realistic network-profile replay is occupied.
delta: Within verified bidirectional pairs, compare original direction, reverse substitution, and explicitly aligned bidirectional mean while holding payload and LiDAR timestamp fixed.
Reject pairs with no reverse channel rather than imputing reciprocity.
candidates.recommendationReason: The counterfactual is clean but too narrow for a separate idea. It strengthens the cross-link and temporal-sufficiency audit.
allowedClaims: CooperScene-specific direction-swap validity test for payload completion.
forbiddenClaims: First discovery of wireless-link asymmetry.
Physical reciprocity conclusion without PHY/MAC or radio-state evidence.

primaryRetainedCandidate.workingTitle: CooperScene 定向吞吐时间结构的最小充分性审计
primaryRetainedCandidate.positioning: The contribution is not trace replay itself. It is a controlled, executable test of which temporal and cross-link structures in CooperScene's released directed throughput are necessary to preserve payload-completion and frozen-model conclusions.

cannotClaim: First real C-V2X cooperative perception evaluation.
First trace-driven cooperative autonomy or collaborative-perception platform.
First latency-aware or historical-feature cooperative perception method.
Measured CooperScene latency, packet loss, jitter, packet delivery, MAC scheduling, or shared-channel cause when those fields are absent from the audited trace schema.
Method-ranking inversion before it is observed under paired, uncertainty-reported experiments.
codeAvailabilityCaveats: CooperScene, RCP-Bench, LRCP, and the MDrive study have verified official repository URLs.
The V2VLC repository was verified but did not contain the promised implementation.
No official public code URL was verified for Harbor, V2X-ReaLO, R-ACP, or SEE-V2X during the frozen search.
CADET's paper points to its official project site; the frozen search did not verify a separate GitHub repository URL.
